description: Screenshot of a Q post (tripcode !!Hs1Jq13jV6, dated 23 Dec 2019) rendered in a dark-theme aggregator view. The post links a YouTube video and asks a series of rhetorical questions claiming Democrats threaten independently elected officials to follow orders, asking who really controls the Democratic party, and ending with the bracketed initials GS, commonly used in Q drops to refer to George Soros.
text: Q !!Hs1Jq13jV6 23 Dec 2019 - 9:48:57 AM. https://www.youtube.com /watch?v=OB_l9wb0dz0. Watch and listen carefully. [D]s threaten and cull 'independently elected' officials to fall-in-line [follow orders] or face being ousted? Who controls the [D] party? Who really controls the [D] party? Threat: If a major political party can be [controlled] does that represent a clear and present danger to the United States of America? [GS]. Q
flags: The claim that the Democratic party is controlled and the [GS] = George Soros implication are the drop's claims, unverified

description: Screenshot of a Q post embedding the well-known May 2017 TIME magazine cover illustration in which the White House morphs into the onion domes of Moscow's St. Basil's Cathedral (filename shown as the-printed-cover-image.jpg). Below the cover, the post text claims that corporate media is politically controlled fake news, asserts six corporations own 90% of media, and urges readers to think for themselves, ending with accountability warnings and the Q signature.
text: the-printed-cover-image.jpg. TIME. PEOPLE around the WORLD are 'WAKING UP' to the FACT (NOT FICTION) that the CORPORATE [[D] party politically controlled] [6 CORPORATIONS OWN 90%] MEDIA [FAKE NEWS] IS NOT unbiased journalism but POLITICALLY MOTIVATED AND CONTROLLED. [STATEMENTS NOT FACTS] THINK FOR YOURSELF AND STOP BEING A SHEEP TO THEIR NARRATIVE. THEY WILL BE HELD ACCOUNTABLE. NOBODY WALKS AWAY FROM THIS. Q
flags: The 6-corporations-own-90%-of-media figure and the media-control claims are the drop's claims, unverified

description: Meme grid contrasting eight TIME magazine covers under the sarcastic headline "How could anyone think the media is biased?" The top row shows four flattering covers of Barack Obama (including "The Contender" and "And The Winner Is..."); the bottom row shows four unflattering Donald Trump covers, including the melting orange face, the hair-on-fire silhouette, Trump swamped in a storm at his desk, and the cover of Trump looming over a crying migrant child. A THE DC watermark appears at bottom right.
text: HOW COULD ANYONE THINK THE MEDIA IS BIASED? TIME. The Contender. TIME. TIME. And The Winner Is... TIME. We've Got M... Work to Do. TIME. TIME. TIME. TIME. THE DC
flags: The media-bias framing is the meme's claim; cover fine print is too small to transcribe fully
Watermark THE DC attributed to The Daily Caller is probable, not certain
